note: One entry per sentence, so each line can be placed on the frame its picture lands. `at` is seconds from the start of the line's scene; `tts/generate.py` writes each line's length to durations.json and the film checks that no two lines overlap. `say` overrides the spoken text where spelling and speech differ.

lines.text: Choosing where to study abroad starts with a hundred open tabs.
Fees that don’t match.
Deadlines that move.
Advice you can’t check.
Scrapal brings it all into one place, and shows you where every answer came from.
Meet Amara. She wants a master’s in data science.
Scrapal asks one question at a time, and her plan fills in as she answers.
In seconds, she has a shortlist.
Each course is checked against her real grades.
No mystery score. Just what she meets, and exactly what’s missing.
Every fee and deadline links back to the university’s own page.
And when there’s no source, Scrapal says so.
Then, the real cost, for the whole degree.
Amara is £7,800 short, and two scholarships could close the gap.
lines.say: Amara is seven thousand eight hundred pounds short, and two scholarships could close the gap.

lines.text: Her agent quoted £12,000.
lines.say: Her agent quoted twelve thousand pounds.

lines.text: Scrapal checks what the university actually published, and flags it when a page changes.
When she’s ready, her application pack is too.
Every document each university asks for, and a personal statement in her own words. Never invented.
Planning a PhD?
Your research stays on your device, and only its topics are searched.
Scrapal finds the supervisors, labs and funding that fit.
One place, for the whole journey.
Scrapal.
Knowledge opens doors.
